prompts.name: vibe-brainstorm
prompts.description: Brainstorm intent, assumptions, options, trade-offs, and next workflow step before coding.

prompts.name: vibe-debug
prompts.description: Debug systematically with reproduction, hypotheses, experiments, root cause, and regression checks.

prompts.name: vibe-doctor
prompts.description: Diagnose repository health across required files, registries, skills, commands, templates, and validation scripts.

prompts.name: vibe-execute-plan
prompts.description: Execute an accepted plan in small scoped steps with visible validation.

prompts.name: vibe-finish-branch
prompts.description: Finish branch work with clean status, final checks, review, attribution, and handoff notes.

prompts.name: vibe-implement
prompts.description: Implement an accepted spec or plan with minimal edits, matching conventions and reporting verification results.

prompts.name: vibe-init
prompts.description: Orient a new session by inspecting instructions, repository state, registries, templates, skills, and next workflow step.

prompts.name: vibe-memory
prompts.description: Create a privacy-filtered durable session summary with decisions, changed files, verification, questions, and next actions.

prompts.name: vibe-merge
prompts.description: Assess merge readiness by checking scope, acceptance criteria, validation, attribution, security, and follow-ups.

prompts.name: vibe-plan
prompts.description: Convert an accepted spec into ordered implementation steps, target files, risks, rollback points, and validation commands.

prompts.name: vibe-receive-review
prompts.description: Triage and address review feedback, rerun checks, and document deferred items.

prompts.name: vibe-reference-add
prompts.description: Add a new reference repository to the Reference Intelligence Layer.

prompts.name: vibe-reference-audit
prompts.description: Audit one or more tracked references and record useful upstream changes.

prompts.name: vibe-reference-index
prompts.description: Rebuild and check the Reference Intelligence Layer index.

prompts.name: vibe-reference-update
prompts.description: Update local files based on audited upstream changes without copying content.

prompts.name: vibe-request-review
prompts.description: Package a patch for useful review with scope, risks, changed files, and validation evidence.

prompts.name: vibe-review
prompts.description: Review the current diff against the spec and plan, prioritizing blockers, missing tests, security, attribution, and scope control.

prompts.name: vibe-spec
prompts.description: Draft or update a concise implementation spec with goals, non-goals, behavior, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and verification strategy.

prompts.name: vibe-subagents
prompts.description: Coordinate bounded subagent or parallel-agent work with clear ownership and integration.

prompts.name: vibe-upstream-sync
prompts.description: Audit tracked upstream references, update reference metadata, and adapt high-fit ideas without vendoring upstream source.

prompts.name: vibe-verify
prompts.description: Verify acceptance criteria before completion with exact commands, outcomes, and limitations.

prompts.name: vibe-worktree
prompts.description: Create or use an isolated git worktree for risky, conflicting, or parallel work.

prompts.name: vibe-write-plan
prompts.description: Write an implementation plan with ordered tasks, target files, risks, and checks.

prompts.name: vibe-write-skill
prompts.description: Create or revise portable Vibe Coding OS skills and update indexes and validation.
